transcript: Sure. So, a disagreement... the one that comes to mind was with a colleague on the product side, Hanh. She wanted to shorten our onboarding call from sixty minutes to thirty, to free up the team. I disagreed pretty strongly, because in my experience the customers who skipped half the setup were the ones who churned in the first three months. We had, um, a slightly tense meeting about it, I'll be honest. Afterwards I thought, okay, I'm arguing from gut feeling. So I pulled the numbers, I went through six months of accounts and compared the ones with a full call versus the ones who, for whatever reason, had a short one. The short-call group churned at almost double the rate. But, and this was the part I didn't expect, when I looked at what we actually covered in those sixty minutes, a good twenty minutes was stuff we could send as a video. So I went back to her and said, you're partly right. We landed on a forty-minute call plus a short video before it. Churn didn't go up, the team got time back, and honestly Hanh and I work together a lot better since then.
